name: Ingestion and knowledge currency pipeline
source_attribution: MKOS V3 Canonical Architecture Specification + Knowledge Currency Principle + Universal Confidence, Uncertainty and Trust Model (Medical Training App Push, week of 10/17/2026)

change_log.summary: Initial ingestion pipeline: Drive scan, change events, classification, impact analysis, queue.
Scanner no longer skips 'Guidelines and Backend'; AI policy per extraction depth; rule-parsed recommendations are linked to concepts by alias matching.
Extraction AI restricted to free services; 3 parts per run; daily budget 250.

watch.skip_note: The Dynamic Board Objective Curriculum folder holds MKOS's own generated objective curriculum (curstore.js); it is written by the server and never ingested as a source.

scan.cadence: every cron tick checks one page of the library (5-minute cron); a full sweep restarts when it reaches the end

classification_rules.class: by title keywords (guideline, consensus, statement, update, schedule, recommendation) else clinical_practice_guideline

classification_rules.when: folder is under Board Exam Blueprints or Blueprint Registries
front matter (cover, contents, index, copyright page)

supersession_detection.family_key: responsible organizations + normalized topic (title minus years, org lists and boilerplate words)
supersession_detection.rule: Within a guideline family, the edition with the latest publication date is current; earlier editions become superseded (or 'modified' when the newer document is a focused update that covers only part of the older one — the older edition stays current for issues the update does not cover).
supersession_detection.owner_override: An explicit status in the owner's guidelines registry (active/updated/check_edition/review_relevance) wins over detection.

scope.pediatric: Pediatric and mixed adult/child sources are ingested and indexed (population=pediatric|mixed) but excluded from curriculum citation and from learner-facing recommendations (owner rule, Oct 2026).

from_source: Educational assets citing the source or teaching those concepts
Curriculum nodes and blueprint topics mapped to those concepts
Competencies developed by the affected objectives

regenerate: educational assets whose citations are superseded

extraction.text: Google Docs exported as Markdown; PDFs converted with Workers AI toMarkdown; text cached in mk_text only while the source is being processed, then dropped (library text is not kept).
deterministic_first: recommendation tables with COR/LOE columns parsed by pattern before AI
metadata (DOI, journal, year) from first pages by pattern
concept resolution by alias table before AI
extraction.ai_step: Only for text that rules could not structure; free services only (Gemini free tier, then Cloudflare Workers AI), never a paid service; the AI returns JSON in the extraction contract; results enter as pending_validation with confidence capped at scoring.ai_extraction_cap.
extraction.budget_note: Calls use the quick (flash-lite) Gemini model, a separate free quota from the default model that writes lessons. The owner changes the budget with settings {path: 'ingestion.extraction.daily_ai_budget_default'}.

ai_policy.recommendations: AI only for parts where no graded recommendation table was found
ai_policy.index_and_facets: AI on every part (concept index and abstracted facts, in the app's own words)
ai_policy.index_only: AI only on the first index_only_parts parts (title pages and table of contents) to index chapters and concepts

validation: no verbatim run longer than 25 words from a licensed_no_verbatim source
recommendation has strength or is marked unstated
no superseded source cited as current
